text: ok this landed but not in the way that it was expected to, can you read the brief again and back through the starting conversation im pretty sure i said that i want to be able to put trees on top of grass but this is canceling out one for the other
resolution: Corrected the flora model after rereading the brief and conversation: the flora channel now contains stackable population lanes instead of one mutually exclusive flora slot, so painting trees no longer cancels grass in the same cell.
